clusters.name: Pasar Makan @ Reservoir (Blk 630)
clusters.notes: The neighbourhood centre. Mostly a breakfast-to-lunch crowd.

clusters.name: Bedok 216 Food Centre & Market
clusters.notes: Big, busy morning centre at Bedok Town. Many stalls close by early afternoon.

clusters.name: Bedok 85 Fengshan Centre
clusters.notes: The east's supper institution — bak chor mee, BBQ and porridge into the night.

clusters.name: Kaki Bukit 511 Market & Food Centre
clusters.notes: Neighbourhood centre between Bedok North and Bedok Reservoir MRT, with plenty of evening and supper stalls.

clusters.name: Blk 538 Bedok North St 3 Market & Food Centre
clusters.notes: Neighbourhood morning centre. Mapped from a Jan 2026 guide and an online roster; details on many stalls still unconfirmed.

clusters.name: Old Airport Road Food Centre
clusters.notes: One of Singapore's biggest and most famous hawker centres — two long rows of legends. Many stalls close by mid-afternoon or on Mondays.

clusters.name: Bedok Interchange Hawker Centre (208B)
clusters.notes: Right beside Bedok MRT and bus interchange; open late, good for a quick bite on the way home.

clusters.name: Pasar 16 @ Bedok South (Blk 16)
clusters.notes: Morning-heavy neighbourhood centre; famous for Hill Street Char Kway Teow.

clusters.name: Tampines Round Market & Food Centre (Blk 137)
clusters.notes: Tampines' classic breakfast centre — most stalls close by early afternoon.

clusters.name: Hawker Centre @ Our Tampines Hub
clusters.notes: Air-conditioned-feel modern hawker centre inside the Our Tampines Hub sports & community complex; open late.

clusters.name: Pasir Ris Central Hawker Centre
clusters.notes: Two-storey newer-generation hawker centre beside Pasir Ris MRT and White Sands; lots of young hawkers.

clusters.name: Changi Village Hawker Centre
clusters.notes: A weekend trip out east — nasi lemak, beef kway teow and dessert by the sea, next to the Pulau Ubin ferry terminal.

clusters.name: Marine Parade Central Market & Food Centre
clusters.notes: Mixed Chinese and Malay neighbourhood centre; Neptune dim sum has run round the clock.

clusters.name: Haig Road Market & Food Centre
clusters.notes: Strong on Malay food — putu piring, mee rebus, soto, satay — plus kolo mee and claypot rice.

clusters.name: Geylang Serai Market & Food Centre
clusters.notes: The heart of Malay food in Singapore — upstairs food centre above the wet market. Busiest during Hari Raya.

clusters.name: Dunman Food Centre
clusters.notes: Small Joo Chiat-side centre that runs late — rojak, kway teow and zi char at night.

clusters.name: East Coast Lagoon Food Village
clusters.notes: Seaside hawker centre in East Coast Park — BBQ seafood, satay and evening breeze. Best in the evening; parking can be tight on weekends.

clusters.name: Eunos Crescent Market & Food Centre (4A)
clusters.notes: Neighbourhood centre near Eunos MRT — prata, briyani and desserts.

clusters.name: Bedok Corner Food Centre
clusters.notes: Small open-air centre at the Upper East Coast end of Bedok Road — lots of Malay food, BBQ and laksa.
